Lena Park: Heads-up: ran into a weird duplicate-create case that only happens when the auth token refreshes mid-retry. Repro in the quickstart.
Marco Ruiz: Interesting. So token rotate + retry = duplicate? Can you paste logs?
Lena Park: Logs: ```
2025-05-01T08:21:10Z WARN req=aa1 status=408 read_timeout
2025-05-01T08:21:10Z INFO retrying req=aa1 attempt=2 backoff=0.6s
2025-05-01T08:21:11Z INFO auth refresh old=tok-9 new=tok-10
2025-05-01T08:21:11Z INFO request req=bb2 status=201 resource=job-77
```
Anya Feldman: Wait, why did retry use a different req id (bb2)? Was an Idempotency-Key set on the original request?
Lena Park: Quickstart didn't set one. But more strangely, our auth refresh middleware is re-building headers and I think it's dropping the Idempotency-Key header if present. I repro'd with a test where I set an idempotency header and the second attempt arrived at the server with no Idempotency-Key.
Marco Ruiz: That explains duplicates — server can't dedupe if key missing. Why would auth refresh drop headers? Our refresh helper calls `make_headers()` after getting new token and doesn't merge the per-request extra headers.
Anya Feldman: Ugh. So flow is: initial request built with idempotency_key -> auth token expired during wait -> refresh middleware builds fresh headers (only Authorization + defaults) -> retry uses fresh headers without Idempotency-Key -> server treats it as new.
Lena Park: Exactly. Minimal repro snippet I used in tests: ```py
client.create_job({'name':'x'}, idempotency_key='k-123', timeout=1)
# simulate read timeout, simulate token refresh during retry
```
Marco Ruiz: We should fix middleware to merge request-specific headers when refreshing tokens. Also add an integration test that simulates token rotation during retry and asserts header preserved.
Anya Feldman: Agreed. Quick fixes: 1) patch auth refresh to preserve/merge per-request headers (Idempotency-Key included), 2) update quickstart to demonstrate idempotency_key usage, 3) CI: add a flaky-network test that rotates token mid-retry.
Lena Park: I'll open an issue and a docs PR. Marco, can you do the middleware fix? Make sure it handles case where per-request header key names vary in case (Idempotency-Key vs idempotency-key).
Marco Ruiz: Good catch. I'll normalize header names to lower-case keys when merging. API change: no user-facing change, just a bugfix. Tests: unit tests for header merge, integration test for full roundtrip.
Anya Feldman: Also let's add a warning in the SDK docs: "If you provide per-request headers (like Idempotency-Key), ensure any auth refresh preserves them; we now do this in X.Y.Z". And add a sample code block showing `idempotency_key=str(uuid.uuid4())`.
